issues.explanation: Chapter 32 prematurely states that Yuan Shang has fled to Zhongshan. In the source, this occurs only later in Chapter 33, after Yuan Tan attacks him following Cao Cao’s capture of Jizhou. Chapter 33 then retells Yuan Shang’s defeat and flight, making the sequence inconsistent across the handoff.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove “袁尚仍逃往中山” from the end of Chapter 32; introduce Yuan Shang’s flight only after Yuan Tan’s later attack in Chapter 33.
